notes: Housing is optional and costs extra. Contact CCM Prep at 513-556-2595 or ccmprep@uc.edu. Tuition assistance may exist; ask CCM Prep.
name: CCM Prep Musical Theatre Intensive
org: University of Cincinnati College-Conservatory of Music (CCM Prep)
what_you_do: You train in singing, dance and acting. Teachers from the conservatory and local pros lead you. Pick a 1 week or 2 week summer session.
who_can_apply: Rising 9th to 12th graders with a strong interest in musical theatre. An audition (video) is required.
pay_detail: Tuition: $1,000 per 1-week session or $2,000 per 2-week session. Housing is an extra fee ($1,000 for a week, $1,800 for two weeks). $35 audition fee; email ccmsummer@ucmail.uc.edu about fee waivers.
duration: 1 or 2 weeks. 2027 sessions: June 14 to 20 or July 12 to 18 (1 week); June 14 to 26 or July 12 to 24 (2 weeks)
deadline_text: Auditions opened Oct 1, 2026. Priority deadline Feb 15, 2027. Final deadline March 1, 2027.
how_to_apply: Audition through Acceptd. Choose CCM Prep: Musical Theatre Intensive. Get ready a headshot and a resume. Prepare a 60 to 90 second speech and two different songs. Send a 30 to 60 second video of you dancing alone.
